records.context: After Mask finishes, inspect overlays and segmentation-QC flags before running :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`; inaccurate masks make every downstream feature inaccurate.  After measurement, use Image UMAP to inspect phenotype structure, colour by laboratory microplate or condition to expose batch effects, and validate clusters against their representative extracted image regions before treating them as biology. Use the Mask tile for :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` and the Image UMAP tile for :func:`generate_image_umap` until those tiles receive separate API pages.
records.label: spacr.core#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: After Mask finishes, inspect overlays and segmentation-QC flags before running :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`; inaccurate masks make every downstream feature inaccurate.  After measurement, use Image UMAP to inspect phenotype structure, colour by plate or condition to expose batch effects, and validate clusters against their representative crops before treating them as biology. Use the Mask tile for :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` and the Image UMAP tile for :func:`generate_image_umap` until those tiles receive separate API pages.
records.translation: Þegar Mask lýkur skaltu skoða yfirlagnir og gæðaflögg (QC) hlutunar áður en :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` er keyrt; ónákvæmar grímur gera hvern eiginleika í síðari skrefum ónákvæman.  Eftir mælingu skaltu nota Image UMAP til að skoða formgerð svipgerða, lita eftir plötu eða aðstæðum til að draga fram lotuáhrif, og staðfesta klasa með dæmigerðum myndskurðum þeirra áður en litið er á þá sem líffræði. Notaðu Mask-flísina fyrir :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` og Image UMAP-flísina fyrir :func:`generate_image_umap` þar til þessar flísar fá sérstakar API-síður.

records.context: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement extracted image regions were not saved.
records.label: spacr.core#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Image UMAP needs an existing ``measurements/measurements.db`` for every source, the object tables and features to include, and reduction/clustering settings. It embeds numeric measurements rather than raw pixels.  Thumbnail images come from the measured ``png_list`` table when ``crop_source='png'`` or are cut from ``merged/*.npy`` on demand when ``crop_source='merged'``; the latter is useful when measurement crops were not saved.
records.translation: Image UMAP þarfnast fyrirliggjandi ``measurements/measurements.db`` fyrir hverja uppsprettu, hlutatöflurnar og eiginleikana sem á að taka með, og stillingar fyrir víddarminnkun/klösun. Það greypir tölulegar mælingar frekar en hrá mynddíl.  Smámyndir koma úr mældu töflunni ``png_list`` þegar ``crop_source='png'`` eða eru skornar úr ``merged/*.npy`` eftir þörfum þegar ``crop_source='merged'``; hið síðarnefnda er gagnlegt þegar myndskurðir mælinganna voru ekki vistaðir.

With more than two classes the frame also carries ``predicted_label`` and one ``prob_class_<i>`` column per class. Results are also written to a CSV file derived from ``model_path`` and the current date.
records.translation: DataFrame-taflan sem skilað er inniheldur alltaf dálkana ``path`` og ``pred``. records.context: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, the merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. records.source: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, the merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. The join key is chosen from ``prcfo``, ``png_path`` and ``file_name``, whichever matches the most rows, with ties going to ``prcfo``; a computed basename is not used. A key that arrives with two different values is written nowhere and counted, rows that cannot be placed are counted, and the merge runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.
records.translation: Þunnur hjúpur utan um :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, sameiningarleiðina sem Classify (CV) og Classify (ML) deila. Lykill sem berst með tveimur ólíkum gildum er hvergi skrifaður og er talinn, raðir sem ekki er hægt að staðsetja eru taldar, og sameiningin keyrir í einni færslu. Sjá :mod:`spacr.predictions`.

records.source: Handles the three shapes that flow through the training path: a ``spacrDataset`` (labels are already a list), a ``torch.utils.data.Subset`` of one (produced by ``random_split`` and by the fold splitter), and the plain list of ``(image, label, filename)`` tuples that ``augment_dataset`` returns. Only the last shape has to be walked, and it holds tensors in memory already, so nothing here decodes an image.
records.translation: Meðhöndlar formin þrjú sem fara um þjálfunarleiðina: ``spacrDataset`` (merkin eru þegar listi), ``torch.utils.data.Subset`` af slíku (búið til af ``random_split`` og af brotaskiptinum), og venjulega listann af ``(image, label, filename)``-tvenndum sem ``augment_dataset`` skilar. Aðeins þarf að fara í gegnum síðasta formið, og það geymir þegar tensora í minni, svo ekkert hér afkóðar mynd.

records.context: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.

records.source: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.translation: Markhlutdeild sýna sem haldið er utan, stranglega milli 0 og 1; hver tala utan þess bils, ``nan`` og ``inf`` meðtalin, er ``ValueError``. Þetta er aðeins markmið. Hlutinn sem haldið er utan er eitt heilt brot í skiptingu í ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` brot, sem er sjálft takmarkað við fjölda ólíkra hópa, svo raunveruleg hlutdeild er bundin við heila hópa og getur skeikað í hvora átt sem er, og það mikið. Yfir átta jafnstóra hópa heldur 0.05 utan 0.125 (engin fínni skipting er möguleg) og 0.7 heldur utan 0.5 (tveggja brota lágmarkið); með einum ráðandi hópi — 70 af 100 sýnum yfir fjóra hópa — halda sömu tvær beiðnir í staðinn utan 0.10 og 0.70. Hvenær sem raunveruleg hlutdeild er fjær en ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` frá þeirri umbeðnu nefnir ``UserWarning`` báðar tölurnar og hvers vegna þær eru ólíkar.

records.context: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per microscope field of view and per microplate sample position, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per field and per well, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.translation: **Þröskuldur án tveggja þýða er handahófskenndur.** Otsu skiptir einni samfelldri dreifingu merkis í tvennt og skilar tölu sem virðist örugg. ``bimodality_coefficient`` og ``qc_flag_unimodal`` segja til um hvenær það hefur gerst, fyrir hvert sjónsvið og hvern brunn, í stað þess að láta það fara fram hjá í hljóði. Sjá :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.

records.context: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a microplate sample position, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a well, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.translation: *Toxoplasma gondii* fjölgar sér með endodyogeny, þar sem tvær dótturfrumur myndast inni í móðurfrumu, svo sníkjudýrabóla geymir 1, 2, 4, 8 eða 16 sníkjudýr — veldi af tveimur. Niðurstaða fjölgunarmælingar er því **dreifing** sníkjudýra í hverri bólu yfir brunninn, ekki meðaltal: meðaltalið 3.2 getur ekki greint á milli "everything at 3-ish", sem er líffræðilega ómögulegt, og heilbrigðrar blöndu af 2 og 4. Lyf sem hægir á fjölgun færir massa úr 8- og 4-flokkunum niður í 2 og 1, og aðeins dreifingin sýnir það.

records.source: This no-op is the fallback used when importing `IPython.display.display` fails. It is imported at module scope, and IPython can be mid-init -- partially imported by another thread -- which makes that import raise. Letting it propagate would make importing this module fail for a reason that has nothing to do with what the module does. spaCR only calls `display` from notebook contexts; the Qt GUI ignores it.
records.translation: Þetta tóma fall er varakosturinn sem er notaður þegar innflutningur `IPython.display.display` bregst. Það er flutt inn á einingarstigi, og IPython getur verið í miðri frumstillingu -- flutt inn að hluta af öðrum þræði -- sem lætur þann innflutning kasta villu. Ef villan fengi að berast áfram myndi innflutningur þessarar einingar bregðast af ástæðu sem kemur því ekkert við sem einingin gerir. spaCR kallar aðeins á `display` í samhengi vinnubóka; Qt GUI hunsar það.
